_readme: Terrain, authored as text, in the same alphabet the character rig uses:
'.' is transparent; '1' '2' '3' are the shadow, base and light tones of this
tile's ramp; 'o' forces the style's outline colour. A tile carries no colour of
its own - that is what lets one bank dress three styles.
Every tile is 16x16, the bank's "tile" size, and a style whose tile_size
disagrees is refused rather than scaled.
"ramp" is the DEFAULT colouring. A style overrides any of it through its own
tile_ramps, and only has to name the ones it wants different.
"solid" becomes a collision shape; "decor" marks a tile that sits ON another
one, so it keeps its transparency instead of filling the cell. A tile that is
